whyItMatters: An effective script or style directive states 'unsafe-inline' without a nonce or hash.
actions: Strengthen the value to the recommended form (nonce-based scripts).
Deliver it on every response type, including errors and redirects.
Set security headers once at the edge or in a single middleware.
verification: Re-request the page and confirm the hardened value; check an error response and a static asset, and confirm the flow the header constrains still works.
